subject: Optimize toolkit commercial options and technical-fit for DataPulse pilot
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@datapulse.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Optimize toolkit commercial options and technical-fit for DataPulse pilot

Hi Claire —

Great to meet on Friday. Per our conversation, I pulled together two lightweight commercial paths that map to the technical options you flagged: (1) cache-first pilot with 3 months of prefunded credits, and (2) a quantization-first pilot focused on TCO for high-concurrency endpoints. Attached is a short PDF that lays out the packaging, expected token consumption ranges, and a recommended set of batch/cache configuration defaults for typical DataPulse workloads (small chat sessions + 1-2 long context lookups).

Short asks from your side so we can finalize:
- Which pilot length do you prefer (6 or 12 weeks)?
- Expected average request size in tokens and percent of sessions that will use cached prefixes (ballpark OK).
- Any strict latency SLOs (<150ms p50 for chat inference) we should honor for the pilot.

If you like, we can lock in a scoped SOW and a credits table — I can have that to you by end of week.

Attachments: optimize_packaging_options.pdf (4 pages, table + config), sample_benchmark_results.csv (attachment stub)

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183

Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for builders
From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@datapulse.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Optimize toolkit commercial options and technical-fit for DataPulse pilot

Thanks Mateo — this is helpful. A few clarifying Qs before we sign a pilot SOW: 

1) Can you send a simple breakdown showing the delta in token/unit costs if we enable prefix/KV caching vs. not (same traffic profile)? Our finance lead wants to see the math.
2) For quantization, you mentioned a ~20–30% throughput improvement for our M60s in the demo — can you confirm expected quality delta at 4-bit vs 8-bit for our retrieval-augmented generation prompts? Any recommended guardrails e.g., fall back to fp16 for specific intents?
3) On discounts: we can commit to a 3-month pilot if you can provide a small starter credit (we typically ask for pilot credits + trial discount). What's the minimum credit package you can do for us to hit sensible throughput?

Also CC'ing Markus (CFO) because he'll sign off on pilot credits. Appreciate a short table with numbers and a proposed SOW draft.

Best,
Claire
Claire Nguyen
Head of ML Products, DataPulse
claire.nguyen@datapulse.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2028 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DataPulse - caching/quantization ask (internal)

Folks — forwarding Claire's note. Quick thoughts:

- Cost math: show two scenarios (no cache, 30% cache hit, 60% cache hit). Use their expected mix: chat avg 180 tokens request, 90 tokens response. 30% cache hits saves ~22% token spend in our model given prefix reuse.
- Quantization: recommend 8-bit for pilot as default; 4-bit only for non-critical endpoints. Provide a quality regression test (we can attach a small eval set) and automatic fallbacks to fp16 when the model confidence or ngram overlap drops below threshold.
- Pilot credits: baseline offer = $25k credits + 10% off list for 3 months, conditional on a 30-day post-pilot exec review and willingness to share a brief case study. If finance pushes back, escalate to 15% list discount + $15k credits.

I'll draft the SOW + pricing table. Mateo — want me to include the automatic fallback policy language?

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Product, Redwood Inference
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@datapulse.com>, Markus D'Souza <m.dsouza@datapulse.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 10:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Optimize toolkit commercial options and technical-fit for DataPulse pilot

Claire / Markus —

Thanks for the questions. Attached is a concise pricing table (pricing_table_DP.csv) and a 2-page SOW draft (DP_SOW_v1.pdf). Highlights: 

- Pilot term: 12 weeks (recommended)
- Credits: $25,000 pre-funded credits applied against tokens and Optimize toolkit advisory time
- Discount: 10% off list rates during pilot; if you commit to a 6-month post-pilot contract within 30 days we escalate to 15% on the contracted term
- Caching scenarios: table shows token cost delta at 0/30/60% cache hit; expected token savings ~20% at 30% cache hit
- Quantization recommendation: start with 8-bit quant for primary endpoints; run an A/B on a 4-bit profile for low-risk endpoints with automatic fallback to fp16 when similarity score < 0.82 or response-quality metric drops >3 pts on your eval set

Attachments: DP_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW draft), pricing_table_DP.csv (pricing scenarios), optimize_packaging_options.pdf (config primer)

Next steps:
1) If this looks good, sign the SOW (I can convert to DocuSign).
2) Provide a small eval prompt set (10–20 items) so our applied ML team can run the 4-bit vs 8-bit regression tests.

Claire — happy to hop on a 30m call Monday to walk the table.

Best,
Mateo
From: Markus D'Souza <m.dsouza@datapulse.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@datapulse.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Optimize toolkit commercial options and technical-fit for DataPulse pilot

Mateo / Grace —

Quick confirmation from finance: $25k credits + 10% pilot discount is acceptable to sign the pilot SOW. Two operational asks before we execute:

1) Please add a one-paragraph clause in the SOW that the credits are non-refundable and will be consumed according to the attached pricing table; audited usage reports will be provided weekly during the pilot.
2) We need a simple rollback plan for degraded generation quality; the automatic fallback Grace suggested is fine — please include an explicit escalation path (support P1 -> 1-hour response, product on-call in 4 hours).

If you add those items I can sign and route internally. Looking forward to the kickoff.

-Markus
Markus D'Souza
Chief Financial Officer, DataPulse
